synthetic_fixture.notes: Deterministic repository fixture. It is used to test the pipeline and must never be represented as real market data.

csindex_official.notes: CSI index market data is subject to index and market-data licensing. Public-site access does not establish redistribution rights.

szse_official.notes: Shenzhen index market data requires an explicit review of page access, automated collection, cloud storage, and project-use terms.

pending_valuation_authorization.notes: Placeholder for index valuation sources. It must be replaced by a publisher-specific source after the exact fields, units, history, automated collection, and private cloud-storage rights are verified.

githubltf_csi300.notes: No data license or redistribution grant was found. Do not copy this repository's CSV into a release.

tencent_raw.notes: Operator approves collection and storage only in the owner-controlled private grid_trading cache. Public release and redistribution remain disabled. Index publisher identity does not select the transport endpoint.

sina_raw.notes: Operator approves owner-controlled private collection and storage for corrected full OHLCV backtest history. Public release and redistribution remain disabled; the endpoint is never an implicit fallback.

akshare_eastmoney.notes: Operator approves collection and storage only in the owner-controlled private grid_trading cache. Public release and redistribution remain disabled. Index publisher identity does not select the transport endpoint.

szse_calendar.notes: Independent monthly trading calendar. Local research access is enabled; calendar cloud collection, storage and redistribution require separate approval from the price provider.

akshare_legulegu.notes: Local research access only. Actual frequency and methods are validated per snapshot. No cloud storage or redistribution approval.

danjuan_snapshot.notes: Local research access only. Actual frequency and methods are validated per snapshot. No cloud storage or redistribution approval.

csindex_optional_history.notes: Explicit optional source, never default or silent fallback. API peg retained as pe_csindex_reported/api_peg rather than relabeled Legu TTM. Operator approves owner-controlled private storage only; public release and redistribution remain disabled.
